entities.summary: Téodor de Wyzewa, born as Teodor Wyżewski, was a writer, critic, and translator of Polish descent, born in Kałusik in the Russian sector of Poland near Kamieniec Podolski, who emigrated to France in 1869. He was a leading exponent of Polish origin of the Symbolist movement in France.
